title: VoC Engine — Unified Taxonomy v1.0
description: Official classification labels for all customer signals. Format: Domain.Capability.Theme. Signal Alpha domains (Authentication, Onboarding) are evaluated first.

Authentication.description: All account access and identity issues.

themes.Failure: General sign-in failure — no more specific cause identified.
themes.PasswordReset: User cannot reset password — reset email not received or link expired.
themes.MultiFactorAuth: MFA/2FA code not delivered, expired, or app not working.
themes.AccountLocked: Account locked due to too many failed attempts or admin action.
themes.InvalidCredentials: Username or password rejected — credentials mismatch.
themes.SessionExpired: User unexpectedly logged out or session timed out.

themes.Failure: Single sign-on (SAML/OAuth) not working — company SSO cannot authenticate.

Onboarding.description: New user registration and initial product setup issues.

themes.Failure: Sign-up form fails, errors on submission, or account not created.
themes.EmailVerification: Verification or confirmation email not received or link expired.

themes.Failure: Setup wizard, initial configuration, or first-run experience broken.

themes.Cancellation: Customer requests to cancel or terminate their subscription.
themes.Upgrade: Customer wants to upgrade or downgrade their plan.

themes.Failure: Payment declined, card rejected, or checkout not completing.
themes.Refund: Customer requests a full or partial refund.
themes.DuplicateCharge: Customer charged twice or billed an incorrect amount.

themes.Query: Question about invoice, pricing, subscription cost, or billing cycle.

Performance.description: System reliability, uptime, and speed issues.

themes.Outage: Service completely down, unavailable, or returning 5xx errors.

themes.Degradation: Pages, reports, or features loading significantly slower than expected.

Compliance.description: Regulatory and data privacy requests — POPIA/GDPR.

themes.DataAccessRequest: Section 23 right of access — customer requests copy of personal data.
themes.DataDeletion: Right to erasure — customer requests deletion of personal data.
themes.DataCorrection: Right to correct — customer disputes accuracy of stored personal data.

themes.Failure: Dashboard, chart, graph, or analytics view not loading or showing errors.
Data export (CSV, PDF, Excel) failing or producing empty/corrupt files.

Integration.description: API, webhook, and third-party connector issues.

themes.Failure: REST API returning errors, timeouts, or unexpected responses.
Webhook events not being delivered or delivery retries failing.
Data sync with third-party system (CRM, ERP, Zapier) not completing.

themes.Delay: No reply from support team or response taking too long.

themes.PositiveFeedback: Customer expresses praise, satisfaction, gratitude, or testimonial with no operational issue.
themes.Inquiry: Customer asks a benign question (pricing, features, hours, documentation, policy) with no complaint and no operational impact.
themes.Unknown: FALLBACK — text is gibberish, off-topic, or genuinely impossible to classify. Do not use when the message fits any other defined category.
